purpose: Bounded small synthetic numerical experiment: one plain-SGD adapter update, exact unmerged serialization/reload, then descriptive BF16 merge comparison. Not restoration training or a quality experiment.

Bind exact report/audit/archive hashes in the future execution contract. A prepared contract or CPU fixture is insufficient.

New no-overwrite run and diagnostic checkpoint names; never modify prior snapshots or completed evidence.

fixed_inputs_model_math.inherit: All bound pretrained, geometry, native sampler/audio, exact input/noise, clipping, full-residency and scoped math definitions from the pinned joint RGB contract unless explicitly changed below.
fixed_inputs_model_math.input_recipe: Same CPU generator: guide randn first, distinct raw warm-start second; actual Comfy joint video-then-audio noise with zeros audio initialization. Save and reuse exact bytes for all four trajectories.
fixed_inputs_model_math.initialization: Verified merged pretrained base, fresh rank8 Kaiming A and exactly zero B from seed101. Do not load prior stage1 or a learned production adapter.
fixed_inputs_model_math.synthetic_target: CPU float32 linspace(.2,.8,128)[None,None,:,None] broadcast to[5,128,128,3]; objective only, never an input/guide/warm-start.
fixed_inputs_model_math.RGB_semantics: Native VAE as_returned_internal_clipped float32; no additional clip/quantization or preclamp claim.
fixed_inputs_model_math.runtime: Same resident NPU, eval mode, static patcher, no low-VRAM/offload/dynamic options. Preserve native VAE internal padding/tiling; block sd OOM fallback. Retain per-recompute DiT/VAE context isolation and instance restoration.

plain_SGD_definition.purpose: Diagnostic one-step update arithmetic and adapter persistence only; not a claim about Adam/AdamW, convergence, a useful learning rate or restoration quality.
plain_SGD_definition.parameter_set: Exactly the400 declared independent FP32 A/B tensors, verified before construction.
plain_SGD_definition.unscale: Save actual raw FP32 gradients, then divide every present gradient in FP32 by1024 exactly once before the single optimizer step. No dynamic GradScaler, clipping, gradient filling, accumulation or second backward.
plain_SGD_definition.update_formula: theta_after = FP32(theta_before - 1e-4 * actual_unscaled_gradient), using declared plain SGD arithmetic.
plain_SGD_definition.initial_A_boundary: At exact zero B, A gradients may be exactly zero. Record all A/B gradients. No weight decay or momentum is allowed to change A independently of this gradient.
plain_SGD_definition.lr_basis: 1e-4 is the existing train_stage1 parser default (line47), adopted here as a predeclared diagnostic constant; its suitability for this RGB objective is not established.

checks: Joint prerequisite independently accepted and evidence hashes bound.
Exact fresh model/provenance, input hashes, original base/VAE parameter and separately registered-buffer fingerprints, full resident state and restoration snapshots.
Exactly200 target modules/400 FP32 tensors; all B zero; A/B shape and scale match each actual base linear; no extra trainable tensors.

phases.operation: One gradient-enabled complete ResidentH3Trajectory sampling and frozen VAE decode, with checkpointed50 DiT and36 VAE blocks. Use one retained graph for the RGB-only MSE multiplied by1024.
phases.reference_boundary: Compare zero-adapter final video/audio and RGB against the accepted joint probe saved reference on exact inputs and bound runtime: H3 strict torch.equal; VAE original allclose(candidate,reference) atol=.0002 rtol=.0001 with bitexact measurement. Reading saved reference arrays adds no model calls.
gates: All outputs/loss finite, same geometry, graph connected.
All400 actual raw and unscaled gradients present and finite; aggregate B nonzero; retained-video gradient present finite nonzero. Do not substitute zeros for absent gradients.
DiT150 and VAE36 candidate forward block calls and corresponding150/36 recomputes, separately counted; base/VAE frozen; no stale graph/session after backward.
Save actual raw/unscaled gradients, parameter-before arrays/hashes and output arrays before any update.

phases.operation: After the retained graph has completed and its contexts have exited, unscale once and run exactly one declared SGD step. Save updated unmerged adapter with provenance to a new diagnostic safetensors file.
gates: Finite adapter values and at least one B value changed from zero; report per-tensor update RMS/norm/changed-coordinate count.
Original pretrained DiT parameters/buffers and VAE parameters/buffers unchanged; no trainable tensor outside the400 adapters.
A changes, if any, must be accounted for by its actual gradient; no hidden weight decay/momentum/reset.
Saved file contains exactly400 keys, each exact actual expected shape, FP32 dtype, finite and byte-equal to the updated live tensor.

phases.operation: Fresh resident session under torch.no_grad, identical official joint semantics/input/noise and frozen native decode. Keep independent FP32 adapter wrappers; do not merge or invoke H3(adaptation_path=...).
phases.record: Save updated-unmerged video/audio/RGB, per-layer adapter and base fingerprints, fixed synthetic loss, clipping summaries and full actual counters. Change vs zero-adapter outputs is descriptive; lack of visible BF16 output change does not justify changing lr.

phases.operation: Exit inference session; destroy live adaptation contents by zeroing all400 A and B tensors and verify actual zeros. Independently read and validate saved file, then check_adapter with complete expected diagnostic contract and L.load(strict=True,strict_unused=True). Keep the same base and unmerged wrappers; perform the identical no-grad inference/decode mode used in phase3.
strict_gates: Exact400-key set, exact per-key shape (no broadcasting), FP32 dtype and all finite before load.
Exact pretrained fingerprint/rank/full diagnostic contract metadata, file SHA and updated adapter byte identity after loading.
Phase3 vs phase4 final video and audio torch.equal and returned float32 RGB torch.equal, all finite; no tolerance relaxation for this same-mode serialization comparison.
Base/VAE frozen fingerprints unchanged; all400 cleared/reloaded tensors genuinely checked; saved checkpoint not overwritten.
phases.why_manual_reload: H3(adaptation_path=...) automatically invokes merge_adaptation_for_inference, so it cannot serve as an unmerged serialization control.

phases.operation: Only after strict unmerged reload passes and all graph/session scopes exit: collect layerwise weight-rounding statistics, call the existing merge_adaptation_for_inference once, verify200 wrappers removed, and run the same no-grad resident trajectory/native decode with identical inputs.
phases.expected_mutation: Only the200 targeted base weight tensors may change through the declared FP32 W+scale*B@A then single BF16 cast. Biases, untargeted base parameters/registered buffers and the entire VAE stay unchanged. Freeze the newly merged model for this final inference; original-base unchanged is not falsely demanded for those declared200 writes.
structural_finite_gates: Exactly200 merge targets, expected BF16 storage, no live adapter parameters, no unexpected mutation, finite resulting weights/outputs and valid geometry.
descriptive_only: For each layer: delta_fp32=scale*B@A, delta_storage=float(BF16(float(W)+delta_fp32))-float(W); norms, changed-weight fraction, count nonzero ideal changes rounded to zero, rounding residual norm/relative norm with denominator-zero handling.
Updated-unmerged/reloaded vs merged video/audio/RGB max_abs, relativeL2, exact-equality flags, fixed synthetic objective and clipping/changed-pixel summaries.
Record forward differences vs the zero-adapter outputs as well, without choosing a best representation or declaring quality.
phases.interpretation: A tiny FP32 adapter change can be swallowed by BF16 weight rounding. Separate-branch (XA^T)B^T with delta cast/add and merged X(W+BA)^T also change multiplication association and rounding, so not all endpoint difference can be attributed only to storage quantization.
phases.no_new_numerical_tolerance: No bitexact equivalence or newly chosen tolerance is required between merged and unmerged arithmetic; differences are measured. Do not increase lr, repeat the update, rescale B or search steps when a change is swallowed.

phases.operation: Save observed arrays/gradients/weight statistics and phase counters atomically; independently verify file/array SHA, exact shapes/dtypes and metadata. Record final parameter/buffer scopes, runtime/math/patcher/wrapper restoration and memory evidence before terminal pass/fail. Preserve partial evidence on every failure.

serialization_provenance.expected_key_formula: blocks.{i}.{target}.lora_{a,b}; i=0..49; target in the four declared target types.
serialization_provenance.expected_shape_formula: A=[8,base.in_features], B=[base.out_features,8] from the verified actual module; no token_refiner tensors.
serialization_provenance.state_dict: L.state_dict(model) serializes FP32 CPU contiguous tensors; verify actual saved tensor values independently.
serialization_provenance.load_caveat: L.load strict/strict_unused checks key coverage only; p.copy_ can broadcast. Explicit exact shape/dtype/finite preflight is mandatory before calling it.
serialization_provenance.metadata: adapter_metadata(pretrained_record, complete_diagnostic_contract, rank=8); complete contract includes source/asset/input/target/sigma hashes, synthetic role, one SGD update, lr1e-4 and unscale1024. check_adapter must receive that exact expected contract, not only rank.

failure_and_scope.i_repeatability: Original i strict gradient equality remains failed; paired-history B remains skipped. No repeated-backward SHA acceptance is inferred here.
failure_and_scope.diagnostic_SGD_vs_future_training: This probe verifies a single declared plain-SGD update and persistence/arithmetic boundaries. It does not verify Adam/AdamW state, convergence, loss reduction, useful learning rate, full-resolution capacity or any real restoration quality.
future_separate_gates: Finite matched raw-guide/Rphi-guide training with verified train-role caches and predeclared future optimizer
